title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
summary: This research paper investigates techniques for extracting and manipulating reasoning traces from proprietary LLM APIs like OpenAI's o1, demonstrating security vulnerabilities in how reasoning chains are exposed through API endpoints.
problem_solved: Exposes and demonstrates security vulnerabilities in proprietary LLM APIs that allow extraction of internal reasoning traces through careful prompting techniques.
why_valuable: Critical security research that highlights privacy and IP protection concerns for companies deploying proprietary AI models via API services.
